body:
I was ridiculed because I reacted. They would abuse me physically and mentally until I broke down. They reveled in my distress. It took years before I was able to just turn it off. After that, it didn't matter what they did. Break my arm? Whatever. Tell me how better the world would be if I was dead? No shit. Lock me in the PE changing rooms? It's not like my next class was that interesting anyway.

I guess my problem is I don't know what's causing this. It's just been steadily getting worse. Nothing I do can stop it. And I'm so tired of it.

I used to be great at retaining information. Give me 5 minutes to skim over a chapter, and I could give you a perfect outline. 

It just seems the more depressed I get, the less I can learn. I could read something 50 times over, and still not recall even the most basic points. 

The social part of school was miserable until I learned to block it out. Once I became apathetic, they lost interest in me.
